test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A shaving mirror is constructed in such way that a man at a distance of 30 cm from the mirror sees his image magnified 1.33 times. Then the radius of curvature of the mirror is:
solution:
The correct answer is **__34.25__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **Object distance (u) = -30cm**
 
• **Magnification (m) = -1.33cm**
 
• **m= -v/u**
 
• -1.33×-30= -v
 
• v= -39.9cm
 
• **Mirror formula= 1/u+1/v=1/f**
 
• -1/30-1/39.9=1/f
 
• -133-100/3990=1/f
 
• -233/3990=1/f
 
• f=-3990/233, f = -17.124cm
 
• Radius of curvature= 2f , 2×-17.124=34.25cm
